items.summary: Radiocarbon dating and isotope analysis of an immaculately preserved skeleton from Mesolithic Denmark indicate that the individual lived through the introduction of agriculture and adapted his diet to the change, providing a unique "eyewitness account" of one of humanity's most significant tech
